extDescription.message: Read foreign-language pages bilingually with a translation provider you configure yourself.

commandToggleTranslation.message: Translate or restore the current page

popupNoProvider.message: No provider configured yet. Open settings to add one.

popupCapReached.message: Volume cap reached; {count} passages were not sent.

popupBrokenRule.message: Rule “{rule}” points at a missing provider; using {provider}.

providerCredentialKeep.message: Saved — leave blank to keep it

providerExtraHeaders.message: Extra headers (one Name: value per line)

providerListEmpty.message: No providers yet. Add the endpoint, credential and model you already use.

routingEmpty.message: No rules. Every page uses the default provider.

glossaryConflict.message: “{term}” already has a required translation for this language pair.

styleInstructionLabel.message: Instruction applied to every translation request

privacyDisclosureBody.message: Page text is sent only to the translation endpoint you configure below. Your credential is stored on this device in extension storage, readable only by this extension's background worker, and never shown again in full. Nothing is sent to the extension's authors; there is no account, no analytics and no vendor server. Extension storage is not encrypted on disk — anyone who can copy your browser profile can read the stored credential. You can remove everything with one action below.

privacyAcknowledge.message: I understand what leaves this device

privacyAckRequired.message: Acknowledge the disclosure before entering a credential.

privacyDeleteAllConfirm.message: Delete every provider, credential, rule, site preference, glossary entry and setting?

privacyDeleteAllDone.message: All stored data deleted and verified empty.

privacyDeleteAllFailed.message: Deletion could not be verified; {keys} still present.

privacyRetention.message: Page content is never stored; only the settings on this page persist.

errorUnreachable.message: Cannot reach the provider. Check the endpoint and your network.

errorTimeout.message: The provider did not respond in time.

errorAuthRejected.message: The provider rejected the credential. Update it in settings.

errorRateLimited.message: The provider is rate limiting requests. Retrying with backoff.

errorQuotaExhausted.message: The provider reports an exhausted quota.

errorModelUnavailable.message: The model is not available. Check the model identifier.

errorMalformedResponse.message: The provider returned an unexpected response.

errorServerError.message: The provider returned a server error. Retrying.

errorCancelled.message: Translation cancelled. Passages already translated stay on the page.

errorWorkerUnavailable.message: The extension's background worker is unavailable. Reload the page.

errorCapReached.message: The configured volume cap has been reached.

errorProviderMissing.message: No provider is configured for this page.

errorStorageQuota.message: Extension storage is full; some settings were not saved.

errorNewerSchema.message: These settings were written by a newer version of the extension. Update it before changing settings.

errorMigrationFailed.message: Migrating stored settings failed at step {step}.

errorRestrictedPage.message: Browser and store pages cannot be translated.

errorStrictCsp.message: This page blocks the extension from changing it.

errorSameLanguage.message: This page already appears to be in the target language.

commonInvalidEndpoint.message: Enter an absolute https URL (http is allowed for loopback).

commonInvalidName.message: Name must be 1–64 characters and unique.

commonInvalidTimeout.message: Timeout must be between 5000 and 300000 ms.

commonInvalidSite.message: Enter a host name or pattern such as news.example or *.example.

commonInvalidLang.message: Enter a language code such as en, zh, ja or auto.

limitsCharacters.message: Character cap per session (0 = no cap)

limitsExplained.message: When a cap is reached the extension stops sending text and tells you which passages were skipped. It never shows a money figure, because it has no pricing information.

errorInvalidRequest.message: The provider rejected the request. Check the endpoint, extra headers and model id.

errorSelectionEmpty.message: Select some text before translating the selection.

errorInvalidConfiguration.message: The provider configuration is incomplete or invalid. Check it in settings.

providerTestNeedsSave.message: Save the provider before testing it.
